title.narrative: Air Quality Cooperation with Georgia: Preparatory Phase

description.narrative: Projektets övergripande mål är en förberedande fas för SwEPA för att ytterligare utforska möjligheterna till ett institutionellt samarbete med Environment Protection and Agriculture och National Environmental Agency om förbättring och förvaltning av luftkvaliteten.

The overall objective of the Project is a preparatory phase of SwEPA to further explore the possibilities for an institutional cooperation with the Ministry of Environment Protection and Agriculture and the National Environmental Agency of the management and improvement of the air quality sector in Georgia.

The overall objective of the preparatory phase with the Swedish Environment Protection Agency is to further explore the possibilities for a future, institutional cooperation with the Georgian Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture and the National Environmental Agency regarding the technical management of and improvement of air quality in Georgia.
